name: OmaCircuitLab
author: Dankestrick
description: A breadboard circuit simulator for learning electronics and robotics. Drop in batteries, resistors, LEDs, sensors, transistors, motors, AC sources and programmable boards, wire them with neat square jumpers, press Run and watch it work. Measure with a multimeter, clamp meter and oscilloscope, and follow 31 step-by-step lessons from a first LED to a wall-dodging robot.
